shots.prompt: The woman in the ivory suit and pearl necklace sharply brushes away the silver-haired woman's offered hand with the back of her hand and says coldly in Japanese, in a haughty voice of a woman in her late 50s, clear lip sync: 「ちょっと、触らないで」 The silver-haired woman freezes.
She wrinkles her nose, waves her hand in front of her face and says with disgust in Japanese, mocking voice of a woman in her late 50s, clear lip sync: 「おむつの匂いがうつるじゃない」
